# Where the answers live

Exercises 4.1–4.3 are edits to the template itself, so the finished files
are in `solutions/templates-solved/`. This document renders through them,
so you can *see* every answer in the output:

- **4.1 Rebrand.** The default in `typst-template.typ` is now
  `brand-color: rgb("#8b1f2d")` — this document sets no `brand-color` in
  its YAML, yet the title and headings are dark red. A document *can*
  still override it from YAML because `typst-show.typ` only passes the
  argument when the key exists.

- **4.2 Footer.** Look at the bottom of this page: document title on the
  left, page number on the right. In the template it is:

  ````
  set page(
    ...,
    footer: context [
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: luma(120))[#title]
      #h(1fr)
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: luma(120))[#counter(page).display()]
    ],
  )
  ````

- **4.3 Subtitle.** The subtitle above is italic, grey and 14pt:
  `#text(size: 14pt, style: "italic", fill: luma(120))[#subtitle]`.

- **4.4 Project-wide format.** Create `_quarto.yml` beside your `.qmd`
  files containing:

  ````yaml
  format:
    typst:
      template-partials:
        - templates/typst-template.typ
        - templates/typst-show.typ
      papersize: a4
  ````

  Then any `.qmd` in the folder needs no `format:` block at all — Quarto
  merges the project settings automatically. (We deliberately do **not**
  ship a `_quarto.yml` in this repo root, so the earlier modules keep
  their self-contained headers for teaching purposes.)

# Proof the template styles content

*Emphasised text* takes the brand colour, and tables get the header
treatment:

```{r}
#| label: tbl-proof
#| tbl-cap: "Styled by the template, not by this file."
knitr::kable(head(ToothGrowth, 4))
```
